title: Pagination offset
skill: Name the file and state the exact paging rules

good: In src/lib/paginate.js, paginate(items, page, size) uses page * size as the offset, so page 1 returns the second page. Pages are 1-based. Rules: start at (page - 1) * size; the last page can be partial; a page past the end returns items [] and keeps the requested page number (remove the clamp to the last page); totalPages = Math.ceil(total / size). Keep the return shape { items, page, size, total, totalPages }. Only change that file. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: Pagination on the posts list is broken. Fix it.
